method: Finish each section, compare the PSYC301 modern structure and Version 20 prose rules with the LING285 evidence, verify the section, then continue.
scope: Separate LING285 modern workspace. Preserve the original workspace and earlier editions.
writing: Teach directly in connected complete sentences. Emphasize useful terms. Avoid lecture narration, report labels, irrelevant asides and unnecessary calculation. Preserve essential quantities and source examples.
interaction: College, Simple and Original wording choices apply only to quizzes and practice tests. Q&A uses PSYC301-style reading disclosures. Writing practice keeps optional saved responses and full answer disclosures.
